name: Dujella–Peral · Rational Diophantine Triple Rank ≥7
description: The 2020 Dujella–Peral infinite family of rational-Diophantine-triple curves with torsion Z/2 × Z/2 and rank at least 7, realized on its genus-1 quartic base.
generic_rank_status: Operational lower bound 7 over the genus-1 quartic base function field. The paper proves an infinite family with rank >=7; exact generic rank 7 is not claimed.

source.name: Andrej Dujella, High rank elliptic curves with prescribed torsion

auto_search.strategy_note: Search only exact rational points of the paper's genus-1 rank-7 base; local quartic square filtering is built into finite-field candidate scoring.

provenance.authors: Andrej Dujella and Juan Carlos Peral
provenance.paper: High rank elliptic curves induced by rational Diophantine triples
provenance.published_claim: The seven points in equation (13) are independent for infinitely many rational base points, proving an infinite family with rank >=7.
provenance.exact_rank_boundary: The paper does not prove exact generic rank 7 for the genus-1 base family. Rank Hunter records only a verified lower bound 7.
provenance.second_family_boundary: The paper gives a second infinite rank>=7 construction from substitutions 2 and 5, but does not print the explicit transported seventh-section formula needed for a release variant; it remains provenance only.
provenance.candidate_boundary: Generic rational w3 values are rank-6 parent fibers. Rank Hunter curve(w3) accepts only exact rational square points of equation (10); curve_mod_p applies the corresponding local square condition during Nagao scoring.

pipeline_search.strategy_note: Genus-1-base rank-7 subgroup plus plugin-local ratpoints; core owns exact certification and promotion.
